test_consideration: Existing strict self-PC interval/instruction and callstack conservation tests. Every selected actual leaf PC must belong to the correct7276 pinned instruction inventory; all sampled periods and phase partitions conserve.
limitation: One matched diagnostic pair, not exact instruction latency or a repetition median. Different code bodies are not paired by offset/index. Sampled skid and instruction/code-layout differences do not by themselves prove a cache, predictor, or compiler-heuristic cause.
